blocks.text: Morgan Creek homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Morgan Creek, September 2026. Detached houses: 45 listed at month end and 5 sold in September, a sales ratio of 11% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 39 listed at month end and 9 sold in September, a sales ratio of 23% (a sellers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 15 sold over 4 months against an average of 45.0 listed, about 12.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 5 sold. Condos and townhomes: 27 sold over 4 months against an average of 37.5 listed, about 5.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 10 sold.

faq.q: Is Rosemary Heights part of Morgan Creek?
faq.a: On MLS®, yes — the live page states the Morgan Creek sub-area includes both the golf course neighbourhood and Rosemary Heights, while the City treats Rosemary Heights as its own planning area with Central and West neighbourhood concept plans

faq.q: Do I need to belong to the golf club to live in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: No — the live page states Morgan Creek Golf Course at 3500 Morgan Creek Way describes itself as a public golf course, so living here is not tied to golf; ask the course directly about membership or course access

faq.q: Which schools are in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: Schools confirmed by name and address against the BC Ministry K-12 file inside this sub-area's ground are Morgan Elementary (3366 156a St) and Rosemary Heights Elementary (15516 36 Ave), with Grandview Heights Secondary at 16987 25 Ave — but catchments are address-based, so check the exact address in the SD36 locator before relying on a school (BC Ministry K-12 file, ~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01)

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 45 houses listed with 5 sold in the month and 39 condos and townhomes listed with 9 sold in the month in Morgan Creek. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Morgan Creek a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 11%, a buyers’ market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 23%, a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
